entries.source: In Hard mode, if everyone in the party has a Death Penalty of 60%.
entries.text: 在困難模式下，若隊伍中所有人的死亡懲罰都達到 60%。
entries.reason: Death Penalty 是死亡懲罰，不是死刑；保留原文的條件片語，不補造後果。

entries.source: 1: clear mobs north and mainly south of your spawn point without aggroing any Abyssal or Shadow Ranger or Rastigan will run forward and probably die which will kill the party.
entries.text: 1：清除出現位置北方與主要位於南方的敵群，但不要引到任何 Abyssal 或 Shadow Ranger；否則 Rastigan 會往前衝，且很可能死亡，導致全隊失敗。
entries.reason: spawn point 指出現位置；補清楚引怪後 NPC 前衝、死亡與全隊失敗的因果。

entries.source: 7*: (optional) you may want to head south toward the Spider Cave to clear it in advance to make next step a bit easier. Move carefully as many spiders will often pop up. Make your way up to the waterfall bordering the Fissure Shore. Beware at this spot as many groups will spawn.
entries.text: 7*：（可選）可向南前往 Spider Cave，事先清除敵人，讓下一步較容易。移動時要小心，許多蜘蛛經常會突然出現。一路前往與 Fissure Shore 相接的瀑布；此處會出現許多敵群，務必留意。
entries.reason: optional 不是選購；pop up 與 spawn 是敵人出現，保留南行、瀑布及多群伏兵警告。

entries.source: 9: take quest The Hunt from Nimros the Hunter: Shard Wolves will spawn at different location in the area, you will kill them while doing the other quests. A first spawn in right behind you.
entries.text: 9：向 Nimros the Hunter 接取 The Hunt。Shard Wolves 會出現在區域內不同位置，可在執行其他任務時順路擊殺。最先出現的就在你身後。
entries.reason: 修正敵人產卵誤譯；保留接取者、任務身份、順路擊殺與第一隻出現於身後。

entries.source: When a player accepts this quest three groups of Grasping Darknesses spawn nearby. Two of the groups spawn on the upper level of the beginning area and begin patrolling there. The third group spawns further away and will patrol from that point to the upper level of the beginning area and back. If the players stay on the lower area they will remain out of aggro range. The groups consist of three or four Darknesses each and aren't difficult to defeat for a prepared party.
entries.text: 玩家接取此任務後，附近會出現三群 Grasping Darknesses。其中兩群出現在起始區域的上層，並在該處巡邏。第三群出現在較遠處，會在出現位置與起始區域上層之間往返巡邏。玩家若留在下層，便不會進入牠們的警戒範圍。每群有三或四隻；準備充分的隊伍不難擊敗牠們。
entries.reason: 保留三群、兩群上層與一群遠處的分布；警戒範圍與每群三四隻不混為全體數量。

entries.source: Be sure to kill all other enemy groups before attacking the Terrorwebs, because after you kill them a Reaper of the Labyrinth will spawn near the statue of Grenth in the chamber. If there are any enemies left at this point they might attack the Reaper and kill it, causing the party to be taken back to to the outpost from which they left to the Underworld. Speak to the Reaper to receive the quest reward. You might also want to save the quest reward for later on so that you can remove Death Penalty with it.
entries.text: 攻擊 Terrorwebs 前，務必先消滅其他所有敵群。擊殺 Terrorwebs 後，Reaper of the Labyrinth 會出現在室內古蘭斯雕像附近。若仍有敵人存活，牠們可能攻擊並殺死 Reaper，使隊伍被送回進入 Underworld 前的據點。與 Reaper 交談可領取任務獎勵；也可暫時保留獎勵，稍後用來消除死亡懲罰。
entries.reason: 先清其他敵群再殺目標的順序不可顛倒；補明 NPC 死亡返城及延後領獎消除死亡懲罰。

entries.source: Pay extra caution at the monuments of Forgotten Vale, Twin Serpent Mountains and Spawning Pools. Kill the surrounding monsters before the Terrorweb Dryders, because otherwise they might attack the Reaper and cause your party to be taken back to the outpost from which you entered the Underworld.
entries.text: 在 Forgotten Vale、Twin Serpent Mountains 與 Spawning Pools 的紀念碑附近要格外小心。先擊殺周圍怪物，再擊殺 Terrorweb Dryders；否則其他怪物可能攻擊 Reaper，使隊伍被送回進入 Underworld 前的據點。
entries.reason: Dryders 是敵人名稱而非烘乾機；保留清怪順序及全隊被送回據點的風險。

entries.source: Almost immediately upon taking the quest, three Skeletons of Dhuum will spawn, one at each spawn point. Shortly after, a group of Terrorweb Dryders (both standard and silver) will spawn to the south (near the bridge), followed by another smaller group spawning to the northeast (by the small hooked pathway). It is important to position your party more or less on the spawns, so that the dryders do not more forward and aggro the Spirits. A third group of three Terrorweb Dryders will spawn near the bridge, further south than the first, about a minute after the quest begins. If your group is fast enough with DPS, both other groups will be dead by the time they spawn. If the Tortured Spirits hadn't taken any aggro, they will have already begun moving towards the Reaper.
entries.text: 接取任務後幾乎立刻會出現三隻多姆骷髏，每個出現位置各一隻。隨後，南方橋附近會出現一群 Terrorweb Dryders（一般與銀色皆有），接著東北方小鉤狀道路旁會出現另一小群。隊伍應大致站在牠們出現的位置，避免牠們向前移動並引到靈魂。任務開始約一分鐘後，第三群共三隻 Terrorweb Dryders 會出現在橋附近，比第一群更南。若隊伍輸出足夠快，第三群出現前就能消滅前兩群。若 Tortured Spirits 未引到任何敵人，此時應已開始往 Reaper 移動。
entries.reason: 逐項保留三隻骷髏、三群時間方位及第三群三隻；修正錯誤的隊伍死亡指涉與乾燥機誤譯。

entries.source: While facing Dhuum, if you die or your death penalty hits 60%, you will be moved next to Mayor Alegheri in the Forgotten Vale and turned into Spirit Form. Players must talk to the Mayor to return to the battle; heroes are returned automatically. Consumables that remove death penalty or grant a Morale Boost can prevent this.
entries.text: 面對多姆時，若你死亡或死亡懲罰達到 60%，就會被移到 Forgotten Vale 的 Mayor Alegheri 身旁，並變成靈魂型態。玩家必須與市長交談才能返回戰鬥；英雄會自動返回。使用能消除死亡懲罰或給予士氣提升的消耗品，可避免這種情況。
entries.reason: 保留死亡或60%兩個獨立觸發條件，以及玩家對話、英雄自動返回的差別；死刑改為死亡懲罰。

entries.source: A timer will appear showing "Time remaining to escape", giving you 3 minutes. The easiest way to complete this quest is to click on Burol Ironfist or Kodan on the way in to the meeting. After the meeting is over (or you and your party members click the "skip" button), just press the space bar to follow them. Your character will follow them, trying to catch up as they run their way to the Asura Gate, possibly catching up to them once or twice on the run. If this happens, just hit the space bar again. A lot of Destroyers will spawn behind your party and chase after. They can be ignored, and it is best to do so as fighting them will eat up time. As you approach the gate, be prepared for your character to stop moving when the NPC you were following enters the gate. Using this strategy, you reach the gate with roughly 1 minute left — provided you didn't stop to fight.
entries.text: 畫面會顯示「逃離剩餘時間」計時器，限時 3 分鐘。最容易的做法是在前往會面途中，先點選 Burol Ironfist 或 Kodan。會面結束後（或你與隊友點選「跳過」後），按空白鍵跟隨他們。角色會追著跑向阿蘇拉傳送門的 NPC，途中可能追上一兩次；此時再按一次空白鍵即可。大量 Destroyers 會出現在隊伍後方並追趕。最好忽略牠們，因為戰鬥會耗費時間。接近傳送門時，所跟隨的 NPC 進門後，你的角色可能停止移動，須留意。若途中不停下戰鬥，採此策略抵達傳送門時通常還剩約 1 分鐘。
entries.reason: follow 是角色跟隨操作而非關注；保留空白鍵重按、NPC進門後停步、3分鐘與約剩1分鐘。

entries.source: If you do decide to fight the destroyers, some things to consider are:
entries.text: 若決定與 Destroyers 戰鬥，可考慮下列事項：
entries.reason: Destroyers 是遊戲敵人而非驅逐艦；保留條件引導句，不補造戰術。

entries.source: All destroyers during this mission are warriors, making them vulnerable to Blindness, Weakness and skills that can disable the attacks of multiple enemies, such as Clumsiness.
entries.text: 此任務中的所有 Destroyers 都是戰士，因此可用盲目、虛弱，以及能妨礙多名敵人攻擊的技能（例如笨拙）對付牠們。
entries.reason: 保留全部敵人皆戰士的限定；Blindness 採病症盲目，Destroyers不誤作船艦。

entries.source: Due to the time limitation, it is unlikely that you will have time to defeat all destroyers if fought individually; Consider running to the end of the mission and fight them all there.
entries.text: 由於時間有限，若逐一與 Destroyers 戰鬥，通常來不及全部擊敗；可考慮先跑到任務終點，再集中對付牠們。
entries.reason: individually 指逐一對付敵人，不是玩家單打獨鬥；保留先趕路再集中戰鬥的策略。

entries.source: Also see the Destroyer-page for general weaknesses of destroyers.
entries.text: Destroyers 的一般弱點另見 Destroyer 頁面。
entries.reason: 修正敵人身份誤譯；保留原文的交叉參照，不新增弱點結論。

entries.source: Now you have to kill 3 Corsair Spies; just attack them and they will die quickly. Afterward, proceed towards the resurrection shrine…where you will die quickly (as Kormir explains Death and the Death Penalty). There you will also learn your first 3 skills and she will explain how to use them.
entries.text: 接著必須殺死 3 名 Corsair Spies，直接攻擊即可迅速擊敗。然後前往復活祭壇；你會很快在那裡死亡，讓 Kormir 說明死亡與死亡懲罰機制。你也會在此學到最初的 3 項技能，她會說明使用方法。
entries.reason: 保留兩處3的不同對象；教學死亡與死亡懲罰不是死刑，專名缺證時保留英文。

entries.source: Fighting the destroyers:
entries.text: 與 Destroyers 戰鬥：
entries.reason: 此處是戰鬥步驟標題；只修正敵人身份，不擴寫不存在的機制。

entries.source: In hard mode, there are only two risky spots: attacking the boss (who can manage to kill one of the recruits) and confronting the 3-4 mobs of corsairs in the upper right. However, you can easily succeed with any balanced group that can deal some damage and heal the recruits as well as party members. When engaging groups, take out the Corsair Healers first and any of their spellcasters next. Take advantage of the morale boosts you get for sinking the ships and go after the boss before tackling the overlapping groups.
entries.text: 困難模式只有兩個較危險的環節：攻擊首領（他可能殺死一名新兵），以及對付右上方的 3-4 群海盜。不過，只要隊伍配置均衡，能造成傷害，並同時治療新兵與隊員，就容易成功。交戰時先擊殺 Corsair Healers，再擊殺其他施法者。利用擊沉船隻獲得的士氣提升，先對付首領，再處理活動範圍重疊的敵群。
entries.reason: mobs 是3–4群而非3–4隻；party members 是隊員，morale boosts 是士氣提升，保留擊殺順序。

entries.source: Complete exploration of this area will yield about 0.2% to the Elonian Cartographer title track.
entries.text: 完整探索此區域，可使 Elonian Cartographer 稱號進度增加約 0.2%。
entries.reason: title track 是稱號進度，不是主打歌；保留約0.2%的估計值。

entries.source: From here, take the lower southern path. Hug the right stone wall and be wary of patrolling Raptors. After a short distance, turn right into a passage littered with Asuran corpses. Renk is here with a group of 4 Destroyers. Although your foes will also target Renk, you can safely ignore him because he will self-resurrect.
entries.text: 從這裡走下方的南側道路，緊貼右邊石牆，留意巡邏的 Raptors。走一小段後，右轉進入散布阿蘇拉屍體的通道。Renk 與 4 隻 Destroyers 就在這裡。敵人也會攻擊 Renk，但不必照顧他，因為他會自行復活。
entries.reason: hug wall 是貼牆走；保留方向、4隻敵人與NPC自動復活的理由，專名不猜官方譯名。

entries.source: If your party gained Death Penalty on your way to this mission or accumulated too much Death Penalty while in this mission, you can simply resign in the mission dungeon, which causes your party to spawn next to Blimm and eliminate the Death Penalty. Talk to Blimm again to restart the mission.
entries.text: 若隊伍在前往此任務途中已有死亡懲罰，或在任務中累積過多死亡懲罰，可直接在任務地下城內投降。隊伍會出現在布林姆身旁，死亡懲罰也會消除。再次與布林姆交談，即可重新開始任務。
entries.reason: resign 是遊戲內投降，不是辭職；保留出現位置、消除死亡懲罰與重啟對話。

entries.source: None of the foes in this quest use hex spells, so hex removal skills are less effective here. However, those skills can still be useful for reaching Blimm in Magus Stones to obtain this quest.
entries.text: 此任務中的敵人都不使用降咒魔法，因此移除降咒的技能在任務內用途較少。不過，前往Magus Stones找布林姆接取任務的途中，這些技能仍可能派上用場。
entries.reason: hex 是降咒而非十六進位；區分任務內敵人與接取任務途中的敵人。

entries.source: The mission is divided into three main parts: (1) defend a set of golem-producing kilns while Sokka makes them fully operational; (2) fight your way to the Destroyer spawning grounds (a burnt out area near the top of the map); and (3) defeat the Bringers of Destruction.
entries.text: 任務分成三個主要階段：（1）保護一組製造魔像的窯爐，直到 Sokka 使它們全面運作；（2）一路戰鬥到 Destroyers 的出現區域，即地圖上方附近的焦土地帶；（3）擊敗 Bringers of Destruction。
entries.reason: 保留三階段順序及焦土地帶方位；spawning grounds 是敵人出現區域，不是產卵場。

entries.source: Fight your way to the spawning grounds and defeat the Bringer of Destruction pair; defeating them completes the mission (you do not have to kill the other Destroyers in that area).
entries.text: 一路戰鬥到敵人出現區域，擊敗兩隻 Bringers of Destruction 即可完成任務，不必殺死該處其他 Destroyers。
entries.reason: pair 明確為兩隻；保留只擊敗兩名目標即可、不必清空其他敵人的完成條件。

entries.source: Go back to the spawning grounds and defeat the Bringers; defeating them completes the mission (you do not have to kill the other Destroyers in that area).
entries.text: 返回敵人出現區域，擊敗 Bringers 即可完成任務，不必殺死該處其他 Destroyers。
entries.reason: 修正產卵場與驅逐艦；保留不必清空敵人的完成條件。

entries.source: If you have trouble with either of the above techniques, then return to the kilns with the entire party after clearing the area between the NPCs and the spawning groups ("Skipping the kilns" method.) The waves of Destroyers that come in afterwards should be easy to dispatch: the mobs are smaller and arrive less frequently. Spark up the Golems and bring them with you to tackle the spawning grounds.
entries.text: 若使用上述任一方法時遇到困難，可先清除 NPC 與敵人出現區域之間的敵人，再讓全隊返回窯爐，也就是「跳過窯爐」方法。之後前來的 Destroyers 較容易擊敗，因為每群數量較少，出現頻率也較低。啟動魔像並帶著它們前往敵人出現區域。
entries.reason: smaller mobs 指敵群數量較少，不是怪物體型較小；dispatch 是擊敗，保留返回與啟動順序。 交叉復審：either 只要求其中任一方法遇到困難，不要求兩種都失敗。

entries.source: This mission presents a good opportunity to farm Destroyers.
entries.text: 此任務適合反覆擊殺 Destroyers 以取得掉落物。
entries.reason: farm 是反覆擊殺取得掉落物；Destroyers 不譯成船艦。

entries.source: Destroyers are immune to burning, resistant to fire damage, and vulnerable to cold damage. A common approach is to combine Winter with any elemental damage.
entries.text: Destroyers 免疫燃燒、抵抗火焰傷害，但較怕寒冷傷害。常見做法是搭配寒冬與任何元素傷害。
entries.reason: 區分燃燒免疫、火焰抗性與寒冷弱點；不把抗性擴大成火焰傷害免疫。

entries.source: Head to Champion's Dawn to talk to Quarrymaster Bohanna. She will tell you to locate Dunkoro. Just follow the quest marker into Cliffs of Dohjok and find Dunkoro to continue the quest. Dunkoro will provide new information on the situation and inform you to join up with Hamar, the quarry supervisor. Just keep following the quest marker until you get to Hamar and a group of Diggers. Talking to Hamar will have them all follow your party as allies.
entries.text: 前往勇士曙光與 Quarrymaster Bohanna 交談，她會請你尋找 Dunkoro。跟著任務標記進入杜夏懸崖，找到 Dunkoro 即可繼續。Dunkoro 會提供情勢的新資訊，並請你與採石場主管 Hamar 會合。繼續跟隨標記，找到 Hamar 與一群 Diggers。與 Hamar 交談後，他們都會以盟友身分跟隨隊伍。
entries.reason: party 指隊伍而非政黨；保留兩次對話的不同觸發作用與全體跟隨結果。

entries.source: Dying from being crushed by the falling crushers does not cause Death Penalty or count as a death against the Survivor title track.
entries.text: 被落下的壓碎機壓死，不會產生死亡懲罰，也不會計入生存者稱號的死亡次數。
entries.reason: 修正死刑與主打歌兩項誤義；保留死亡懲罰和稱號死亡計數是兩個獨立豁免。

entries.source: Dragon Festival quests have been known to interfere with the yeti spawning.
entries.text: 已知龍節任務會干擾雪人的出現。
entries.reason: spawning 指NPC出現而非產卵；保留來源的已知干擾，不斷言每次都不出現。

entries.source: If your party wipes multiple times and you rack up Death Penalty, try approaching from the right and pulling the Effigies aside. Then when you die, go around the left side, killing Charr and not aggroing the Effigies, and take out Maultooth.
entries.text: 若隊伍多次全滅、累積大量死亡懲罰，可嘗試從右側接近，先把 Effigies 引到一旁。死亡後再繞左側，擊殺夏爾，避免引到 Effigies，然後擊殺 Maultooth。
entries.reason: wipe 是全滅而非擦拭；保留右側引怪、死亡後左側繞行的兩段策略。

entries.source: Heading to the third location to Gron Fierceclaw, watch out for Molotov Rocktail along the way, a gigantic Devourer with his own mob of Rockshot Devourers that causes huge damage. Killing it will give you bonus morale and 50 Vanguard reputation points. Gron is nearby. There is also a second, smaller Siege Devourer that you can tame and mount, though this isn't necessary.
entries.text: 前往第三處 Gron Fierceclaw 所在位置時，要留意沿途的 Molotov Rocktail。牠是巨型 Devourer，帶著一群 Rockshot Devourers，能造成大量傷害。擊殺牠可獲得額外士氣與 50 點先鋒聲望。Gron 就在附近。此外還有第二隻較小的 Siege Devourer，可馴服並騎乘，但這並非必要。
entries.reason: mount 是騎乘而非安裝；保留50聲望、額外士氣及第二隻非必要的限制。

entries.source: An Armored Saurus will move to the gate in an attempt to break it. With all of the 16 Charr Seekers alive (two groups of 4 on each side of the gate), the saurus will be unable to come close to the gate. If it dies, another one will spawn shortly thereafter and give it another try. The seekers also have their numbers maintained by spawning. Turn your attention to the Saurus after you've established a steady state as described in the previous section; there is no pressure to hurry that process along or to panic.
entries.text: 一隻 Armored Saurus 會走向大門，試圖破門。若 16 名 Charr Seekers 全數存活（門的每側各有兩群，每群 4 名），牠就無法靠近。牠死亡後不久，會再出現另一隻嘗試破門；Seekers 也會持續補充，以維持數量。依上一節的方法使局面穩定後，再把注意力轉向 Saurus 即可，不必急躁或慌張。
entries.reason: 核對16名等於兩側各兩群4名；spawning 是補充敵人，保留先穩定局面再轉目標。

entries.source: The Destroyers and Charr will be hostile to each other; lean back and watch them destroy each other. Once they are finished, quickly jump in to finish off the remaining Destroyers while they are still damaged.
entries.text: Destroyers 與夏爾彼此敵對，可先旁觀牠們互相攻擊。戰鬥結束後，趁殘存的 Destroyers 仍受傷時，迅速上前消滅牠們。
entries.reason: 敵對對象是兩類敵人；保留先等互鬥結束、再趁殘血擊殺的先後關係。

entries.source: If the boss and its mob (that are encountered at point 1B on the map) are not killed, the remaining allied NPCs (Ascalonian Warriors, Master Armin Saberlin, Ascalon Militia, Ascalonian Rangers) will continue to follow the party leader through the entire mission and Master Armin Saberlin will not offer the bonus objective (which is not required to complete the bonus). This makes the mission easier, since the NPCs will continue to fight alongside your party instead of stopping at point 1B. Sometimes the soldier that is captured with Trooper Deeter Saberlin is stuck in the entry of the prison, preventing you from talking to Deeter Saberlin to complete the bonus.
entries.text: 若不擊殺地圖 1B 點的首領與其敵群，其他盟友 NPC（Ascalonian Warriors、Master Armin Saberlin、Ascalon Militia、Ascalonian Rangers）就會在整個任務中持續跟隨隊長。Master Armin Saberlin 不會提出額外目標，但完成額外獎勵並不需要他提出目標。NPC 不會停在 1B 點，而會繼續協助戰鬥，使任務更容易。有時與 Trooper Deeter Saberlin 一同被俘的士兵會卡在牢房入口，導致無法與 Deeter Saberlin 交談完成額外獎勵。
entries.reason: mob 指首領敵群；修正士兵被誤成計程車，並保留不提出目標不等於無法完成額外獎勵。

entries.source: Defeat the attacking Destroyers.
entries.text: 擊敗前來攻擊的 Destroyers。
entries.reason: 目標是來襲敵人，不是攻擊中的船艦；保留任務目標語氣。

entries.source: This quest prevents Dazehl Brainfreezer and the imps in the southwest corner of the northwestern lake from spawning.
entries.text: 啟用此任務時，Dazehl Brainfreezer 與西北方湖泊西南角的小惡魔不會出現。
entries.reason: prevents spawning 指任務抑制敵人出現；保留湖泊位置的西北與湖內西南兩層方位。

entries.source: Don't move after crossing the portal to Jaga Moraine. Use the mission map to flag one or more heroes or henches to the Sacred Altar (quest objective) to claim it without a fight. Alternatively, when doing the mission without heroes, stand near the edge of the shrine but do NOT cross the quest marker as it will spawn foes. Wait a few minutes until you get a morale boost then run to the bear spirit.
entries.text: 穿過傳送門進入 Jaga Moraine 後，不要移動。可用任務地圖插旗，命令一名或多名英雄或傭兵前往任務目標 Sacred Altar，不經戰鬥便占領它。若不帶英雄，也可站在祭壇邊緣附近，但不要越過任務標記，否則會觸發敵人出現。等待幾分鐘，取得士氣提升後，再跑向熊靈。
entries.reason: flag 指插旗命令英雄或傭兵；保留兩種免戰方法、不可越過標記及取得士氣後再移動。

entries.source: You have to rid the Sacred Altar of Arctic Nightmares to be able to capture it. Capturing the shrine works just like control points in Alliance Battles. When taken, you will gain a morale boost and the Bear Spirit will appear. She will offer you the quest.
entries.text: 必須先清除 Sacred Altar 的 Arctic Nightmares，才能占領祭壇。占領方式與同盟戰的控制點相同。占領後會獲得士氣提升，熊靈也會出現，由她提供任務。
entries.reason: taken 是占領而非服用；保留清怪、占領、士氣與任務提供者的因果順序。

entries.source: Rescue the soldiers taken prisoner by the Charr.
entries.text: 營救被夏爾俘虜的士兵。
entries.reason: soldiers 指士兵；移除計程車誤譯，保留營救目標。

entries.source: Beware the Charr Mesmers who use Power Block which can shutdown your party's casters.
entries.text: 小心夏爾幻術師；他們會使用強力封鎖，壓制隊伍中的施法者。
entries.reason: casters 是施法者，不是腳輪；shutdown 指戰鬥壓制，不是關閉角色。

entries.source: On the first level, you start at the bottom of the map shown; go Northwest and turn East and then North to a gate which will open for you. You will see the Shrine of the Raven Spirit ahead of you, but as you approach, a Destroyer Tremor will pop up in front of it, and two more Destroyers spawn from the northeast. After you defeat them, 2 more Destroyers will spawn to the west, then the southwest corner, then the southeast corner of the room. After defeating the last group, you gain a morale boost, and can receive Raven Blessing from the shrine or from Olaf. You don't need to take the blessing; it is optional.
entries.text: 第一層從所示地圖下方開始。先向西北走，再往東，接著向北前往會自動開啟的大門。前方是Raven Spirit 的祭壇；接近時，一隻 Destroyer Tremor 會出現在祭壇前，另有兩隻 Destroyers 從東北方出現。擊敗牠們後，房間西方會再出現 2 隻 Destroyers，接著是西南角，再來是東南角。擊敗最後一群後會獲得士氣提升，並可向祭壇或 Olaf 取得Raven Blessing。是否接受祝福由你決定，並非必要。
entries.reason: 保留西北→東→北路線及後續敵人的出現順序；祝福可選，不誤作必備。

entries.source: Heading back south out of the room, you will see groups of Destroyers, each with a Destroyer Tremor and two other Destroyers. Aim for the Tremors first, interrupting if possible, and follow the path from one group of Destroyers to the next to find the portal to the next level.
entries.text: 向南離開房間後，會遇到數群 Destroyers，每群有一隻 Destroyer Tremor 與另外兩隻 Destroyers。先攻擊 Tremor，並盡量中斷牠的技能。沿路逐群前進，即可找到通往下一層的傳送門。
entries.reason: 核對每群一加二的組成；敵人不以艘計，保留優先目標與中斷建議。

entries.source: On the second level, you start at the bottom of the map shown; head straight North around the first group of Vaettirs, then West through the doorway. Destroyers will kill off any other groups of Vaettirs you come by when you go near them, but you can head North then West again to avoid them and reach the portal to the third level. It is easily possible to avoid contact with any foes on this level.
entries.text: 第二層從所示地圖下方開始。繞過第一群 Vaettirs 直往北走，再往西穿過門口。接近其他 Vaettirs 敵群時，Destroyers 會將牠們消滅；但你可再次往北、再往西，避開敵人並抵達第三層傳送門。這一層很容易全程不與任何敵人接觸。
entries.reason: 保留北→西→北→西路線與兩類敵人互戰；level 是地下城層數，不是角色等級。

entries.source: On the third level, you start at the top of the map shown; hug the wall to the right and head straight to the group on that side. As soon as you aggro them, the group from the left will move to the middle of the room where a hidden Destroyer Tremor waits, so be careful. Proceed south slowly. There is another hidden Destroyer Tremor just after of the next group of Destroyers. After defeating them, head into the southwest room. You will see the Asura Gate ahead of you, but there are a number of Destroyers and 2 hidden Destroyer Tremors in between, one about halfway into the room and the other just in front of the gate.
entries.text: 第三層從所示地圖上方開始。貼著右牆直接走向該側敵群。引到牠們後，左側敵群就會移往房間中央，該處藏著一隻 Destroyer Tremor，須格外小心。緩慢往南前進；下一群 Destroyers 的後方也藏著一隻 Tremor。擊敗牠們後，進入西南方房間。前方就是阿蘇拉傳送門，但途中有多隻 Destroyers 與 2 隻隱藏的 Tremors：一隻約在房間中央，另一隻就在門前。
entries.reason: 保留左右群觸發關係、南行路線及末房兩隻隱藏敵人的不同位置；移除船艦量詞。

entries.source: Destroyers are vulnerable to cold damage. You can convert most damage into cold damage by combining Greater Conflagration (turns physical into fire damage) and Winter (turns elemental into cold damage).
entries.text: Destroyers 較怕寒冷傷害。可搭配 Greater Conflagration（將物理傷害轉為火焰傷害）與寒冬（將元素傷害轉為寒冷傷害），把大部分傷害轉為寒冷傷害。
entries.reason: 明確保留兩次不同範圍的傷害轉換，不把物理直接等同元素；無中文佐證技能保留英文。

entries.source: Clear the Central Transfer Chamber of Destroyers.
entries.text: 清除中央傳送室內的 Destroyers。
entries.reason: clear chamber of foes 指清除室內敵人，不是清除整個房間；修正主賓關係。

entries.source: As Destroyers only gain 2 levels in hard mode their health isn't significantly increased. However, their damage is much higher. As such it is highly recommended to go to the ice bridge and let the golems body block it, as stated above, to protect your party on level 2. It is also much more important to not aggro more than one group, and not to ball up as the melee destroyers have highly effective area of effect damage that is boosted enough in hard mode to be able to quickly wipe an unprepared party.
entries.text: Destroyers 在困難模式只提高 2 級，因此體力沒有明顯增加，但傷害高出許多。因此強烈建議依前述方法前往冰橋，讓魔像以身體阻擋通道，保護第 2 層的隊伍。更要避免同時引到多群敵人，也不要全隊擠在一起；近身 Destroyers 的範圍傷害在困難模式大幅提高，可迅速消滅準備不足的隊伍。
entries.reason: 區分敵人只提高2級與體力增幅不大；不得把avoid aggro多群誤成玩家不可聚集多群。

entries.source: Aggravate the Great Destroyer so he will attack your party on this plate. If it uses Lava Wave turn your attention temporarily to other Destroyers until it rises back up. Continue until the Great Destroyer is defeated.
entries.text: 引到 Great Destroyer，讓牠在這塊平台上攻擊隊伍。若牠使用 Lava Wave，先轉而攻擊其他 Destroyers，直到牠再次浮起。反覆進行，直到擊敗 Great Destroyer。
entries.reason: plate 在場景中指平台而非餐盤；保留使用技能後暫時轉火、浮起再戰的時序。

entries.source: Keep in mind that any member of your party can remove the hex and the quest will be successful, and also that Taya carries the skill Remove Hex and will use it to complete the quest for you.
entries.text: 隊伍中任何成員移除該降咒，都能完成任務。此外，Taya 帶有降咒消除，會使用它替你完成任務。
entries.reason: hex 指降咒，不是十六進位；保留任一隊員皆可及NPC可代為完成兩種途徑。

entries.source: Holy Veil can not be used to remove the hex for some reason, you will have to re-zone and bring a different hex removal
entries.text: 不明原因導致神聖遮罩無法移除此降咒。必須重新進入區域，並改帶其他移除降咒的技能。
entries.reason: re-zone 是重新進入區域，不是重新分割；保留來源不明原因，不推導新機制。

entries.source: Condition removal and hex removal skills, to counter Skeleton Mesmer's Ineptitude and Fragility.
entries.text: 攜帶移除病症與移除降咒的技能，以對付 Skeleton Mesmer 使用的愚蠢與脆弱。
entries.reason: condition 指病症，hex 指降咒；保留兩類移除技能及其針對的兩項技能。

entries.source: Hex removal skills could be unnecessary; the only hex spells your party will encounter are Enchanter's Conundrum (the hex that is applied has no impact if your party does not use enchantments) and Life Siphon (ends when its caster dies).
entries.text: 移除降咒的技能可能不必要；隊伍只會遇到附魔者之謎（若隊伍不使用加持，其降咒便沒有影響）與吸取生命（施法者死亡時結束）這兩種降咒魔法。
entries.reason: 保留可能不需要的限定，並分開兩種降咒各自失去作用的條件。

entries.source: Hexes are less effective as Skeleton Mesmers and Monks carry Shatter Hex and Smite Hex respectively. On the opposite, none of the foes carry condition removal, so conditions are effective.
entries.text: 降咒的效果較差，因為骷髏幻術師與骷髏僧侶分別帶有降咒粉碎與降咒懲戒。相反，敵人都沒有移除病症的技能，因此施加病症很有效。
entries.reason: Monks 是僧侶而非武士；核對分別對應兩技能，並保留所有敵人都無病症移除的條件。

entries.source: Players start the mission looking for Blade Scout Ryder and his party. Saidra informs the party that Ryder has gone ahead and drops a Vine Seed. Drop the seed on the designated spot to create a vine bridge. Along the way there are 3 more Vine Seed Flowers (points A and C) which, when clicked, yield a Vine Seed to create bridges at spots marked by a glowing circle on the jungle floor (several of which are marked B on the map).
entries.text: 任務開始時，玩家要尋找光刃公會斥候萊德與他的隊伍。Saidra 會告知萊德已先行，並放下一顆 Vine Seed。在指定位置放下種子，即可形成藤橋。途中還有 3 株 Vine Seed Flowers（A、C 點），點選後可取得 Vine Seed，用來在叢林地面的發光圓圈處造橋，其中數處在地圖上標為 B。
entries.reason: party 是隊伍；保留先取得種子再於光圈放下造橋、三株植物及A/C/B各自標記的意義。

entries.source:
Chaos Dmg: 9-16 (Requires 5 Domination Magic)
Health +10
Health +10 (while Hexed)
Health +10 (while Enchanted)
entries.text:
混沌傷害：9-16（需要支配魔法 5）
體力 +10
體力 +10（受到降咒時）
體力 +10（受到加持時）
entries.reason: 核對傷害範圍、屬性需求與三項各10體力；兩個條件分屬降咒及加持，不視為同時需求。

entries.source: The final groups of foes within the fortress are primarily tightly packed casters. Panic and other AoE denial will have great impact on them.
entries.text: 要塞內最後幾群敵人主要是聚在一起的施法者。恐慌與其他範圍壓制技能對他們十分有效。
entries.reason: casters 是施法者；AoE denial 指範圍壓制，不是拒絕或傷害數值。

entries.source: Energy +5 (while Hexed)
entries.text: 能量 +5（受到降咒時）
entries.reason: Hexed 是受到降咒的裝備條件，不是十六進位狀態；保留能量加成5。

entries.source: East of Less is another area with three thorn-pedestals. One is a spawn-pedestal, one attunement-pedestal has already been claimed by the Mantle, and the third will be unclaimed. There are several ways to proceed at this point. Generally, you want to defeat the two groups of Mantle (including a Boss), visit the spawn-pedestal, talk to the Druid, grab a crystal, claim the right attunement-pedestal and eventually claim the leftmost pedestal, which opens another vine-gate at the eastern end of the area.
entries.text: Less 東側另有一處區域，設有三座荊棘基座：一座供水晶出現，一座調諧基座已被白斗篷占領，第三座則尚未被占領。此處有幾種走法。一般可先擊敗兩群白斗篷（含一名首領），到水晶出現的基座，與德魯依交談並拿取水晶，再占領右側調諧基座，最後占領最左側基座；如此便會開啟區域東端的另一道藤蔓門。
entries.reason: Mantle 指白斗篷而非地函；保留三座基座的不同狀態、先右後最左的開門順序。

entries.source: Remember that killing the runner gives the Mantle an advantage: a living runner will have to return to grab a crystal, while reinforcement runners spawn near their team's crystal-supply pedestal. It also means that you might have to confront two teams of Mantle (the original escorts and the new runner's team).
entries.text: 要記住，擊殺搬運者反而有利於白斗篷：存活的搬運者必須折返拿水晶，但增援搬運者會直接出現在己方供應水晶的基座附近。這也可能使你同時面對兩隊白斗篷，也就是原本的護衛與新搬運者的隊伍。
entries.reason: 比較存活者折返與新援就近出現的差別；保留可能同時面對兩隊的原因，非勸玩家任意擊殺。

entries.source: This is one of only a few Morale Boosts that also apply to Animal companions.
entries.text: 這是少數也能作用於動物夥伴的士氣提升之一。
entries.reason: 修正計程車氣的切詞錯誤；保留少數及也作用於動物夥伴，不擴大成所有士氣提升。

entries.source: After removing foes from the gate area, you have to clear out 10 enemy groups from the area. Seven are within Shaemoor proper, including Justiciar Sevaan's (5). The other three groups spawn outside the city and charge in later; pay attention to avoid getting pinned. Once all 10 groups are defeated, use the lever to raise the gate, and head up to the fountain to kill Aily the Innocent (6). Aily is guarded by 4 other Jade constructs and is a potent healer. However, dropping an Asuran Beacon at his feet will damage him enough to make him a quick kill. Any remaining Jade constructs die the moment Aily dies, so focus your attention on him. The party will automatically be brought to the western end of Talmark Wilderness 15 seconds after Aily dies.
entries.text: 清除大門附近敵人後，還須消滅區域內 10 群敵人。其中七群位於夏恩摩城內，包括 Justiciar Sevaan 的隊伍（5）；另外三群稍後會在城外出現並衝入，須留意避免被夾擊。全部 10 群消滅後，操作拉桿升起大門，前往噴泉擊殺 Aily the Innocent（6）。他有另外 4 個 Jade constructs 保護，且治療能力強；但在他腳邊放下 Asuran Beacon，便能造成足夠傷害，迅速擊殺。Aily 死亡時，殘存的 Jade constructs 也會立即死亡，因此應集中攻擊他。Aily 死亡 15 秒後，隊伍會自動被送往突馬克荒地西端。
entries.reason: 核對七加三共十群、四護衛及死亡15秒後傳送；修復15被錯接到地名的誤序。

entries.source: There are 10 groups along the way, but you can skip them all by allowing your team to die; you will resurrect at the lab. (Remember to flag those heroes without resurrection skills away, so they do not end up with death penalty.) You are not required to pick-up Asuran Beacons to complete the quest, but they are very helpful. However, if you are doing this using only heroes and henchmen, hold off on grabbing one so that it does not slow you down; once you have cleared Shaemoor, you can return to Zinn.
entries.text: 沿途有 10 群敵人，但可讓隊伍死亡以跳過，之後會在實驗室復活。記得先插旗，將沒有復活技能的英雄留在遠處，避免他們承受死亡懲罰。完成任務不必拿取 Asuran Beacons，但它們很有幫助。若只帶英雄與傭兵，先不要拿取，以免減慢速度；清除夏恩摩後，再返回 Zinn 身邊即可。
entries.reason: 保留未帶復活技能英雄須插旗離開的具體動作；修正死刑，並區分有幫助與完成任務必要。

entries.source: Anti-caster skills, such as Scourge Healing, Backfire, and Broad Head Arrow.
entries.text: 對付施法者的技能，例如災禍治癒、魔力反噬與闊首箭。
entries.reason: anti-caster 是對付施法者，不是反腳輪；技能名稱採固定中文術語。

entries.source: The environmental effects in this room are limited to inside the wards throughout the area. Try not to stand in these wards while fighting. Crystal Guardians guard the halls here and carry a nasty Shock/Aftershock combo. Luckily, they rarely use the combo in the correct sequence. Forgotten Arcanists will often be in side rooms, intercepting players in the main corridor as they pass by. Defeat the Facet of Elements at the back to proceed to the last Facet.
entries.text: 此房間的環境效果只作用於各處結界內。戰鬥時盡量不要站在結界中。Crystal Guardians 守在廳堂，帶有危險的電擊／餘震連技；幸好牠們很少依正確順序使用。Forgotten Arcanists 常躲在側室，攔截經過主走廊的玩家。擊敗後方的 Facet of Elements，即可前往最後一個 Facet。
entries.reason: wards 指結界而非病房或守衛；環境效果只限結界內，不誤稱整個房間都有效。

entries.source: Crystal Haze - An AoE hex that can render casters useless, spread before the battle. Revealed Hex/Inspired Hex are optimal counters as with all monster skill hexes, they are not replaced and recharge instantly. For those using henchmen/heroes, set the heroes to avoid combat and block healing skills for the duration of this dangerous hex.
entries.text: 水晶迷霧：能使施法者失去作用的範圍降咒，戰前應先分散站位。降咒顯露與降咒吸收最適合對付它；如同移除其他怪物技能降咒時，技能不會被替換，且會立即完成冷卻。帶傭兵或英雄時，在此危險降咒持續期間，將英雄設為避免戰鬥，並停用治療技能。
entries.reason: spread 指隊伍分散站位；counters 指應對技能，block healing 指停用英雄技能，不是格擋治療。

entries.source: Crystal Bonds - A hex spell that removes and prevents enchantments to target but doesn't apply to self-enchantments (dervish) nor party wide spells e.g. Aegis. It only inhibits protection monks.
entries.text: Crystal Bonds：會移除目標身上的加持，並阻止其獲得加持的降咒魔法；但不影響自我加持（如神喚使），也不影響神賜之盾等全隊法術。它只會限制防護僧侶。
entries.reason: 保留自我加持與全隊法術兩項例外；Dervish 採神喚使，Monk 採僧侶，不用職業外的字義。

entries.source: Hex removal such as Inspired Hex or Revealed Hex to counter Crystal Haze. The overcast this hex causes will quickly shut down spellcasters if it is not removed.
entries.text: 攜帶降咒吸收或降咒顯露等移除降咒的技能，以對付水晶迷霧。若不移除，此降咒造成的過載（Overcast）會很快壓制施法者。
entries.reason: overcast 是過載機制而非陰霾天氣；保留未移除降咒才持續壓制的條件。

entries.source: Hex removal skills are unnecessary if your party members do not have signets or enchantments equipped. The only hex spells you will encounter are Rust (Corsair Wind Master), Defender's Zeal and Scourge Enchantment (General Bayel).
entries.text: 若隊員都未裝備紋章或加持，就不需要移除降咒的技能。途中只會遇到紋章鏽蝕（Corsair Wind Master）、防禦者狂熱與災禍加持（General Bayel）這些降咒魔法。
entries.reason: signets 是紋章；保留全隊沒有兩類技能的前提，並將三種降咒對應至正確敵人。

entries.source: This mission adds approximately 1.1% to the Tyrian Cartographer title track.
entries.text: 此任務可使 Tyrian Cartographer 稱號進度增加約 1.1%。
entries.reason: title track 指稱號進度；保留約1.1%的估計，不改成固定必得數值。

entries.source: Last Rites of Torment can be removed from the entire party nearly-instantly using Inspired or Revealed Hex. Hex Eater Signet will remove that hex from over half the team, if they are within range.
entries.text: 用降咒吸收或降咒顯露，幾乎可立即為全隊移除 Last Rites of Torment。若隊員在範圍內，噬咒紋章則能替超過半隊的人移除此降咒。
entries.reason: Inspired 為同句縮寫，補全技能身份；保留幾乎立即、範圍內與超過半隊三項限制。

entries.source: Consider consumables such as Death Penalty removal and/or summoning stones.
entries.text: 可考慮使用消除死亡懲罰的消耗品，以及／或召喚石。
entries.reason: 死刑改為死亡懲罰；保留消耗品與召喚石可擇一或並用。

entries.source: You start in the village (point 1 on the map); after some dialogue you will be told that the only way in which the Harbingers may take any damage is by using the skill Vial of Purified Water on them. Talk to Elder Jonah to receive this skill, a hex spell which at least one player character needs to equip (heroes cannot equip the skill). Taking the Vial of Purified Water is the trigger for additional Margonite forces to spawn and begin attacking the village. Consider waiting to take the skill from him until you kill some of the Margonite groups around the village along the bone crag path, up to the location where the Harbinger of Nightfall will spawn, as doing this will make the fight to defend the village easier.
entries.text: 任務從村莊開始（地圖 1 點）。對話會說明，只有對 Harbingers 使用 Vial of Purified Water，才能使其受到傷害。與 Elder Jonah 交談可取得此降咒魔法，至少一名玩家角色必須裝備；英雄無法裝備。取得 Vial of Purified Water 會觸發額外 Margonite 部隊出現並攻擊村莊。因此可先沿骨岩小徑，清除村莊周圍直到 Harbinger of Nightfall 預定出現位置之間的部分敵群，再向他領取技能，使守村戰鬥較容易。
entries.reason: 保留唯一傷害手段、至少一真人裝備且英雄不能裝備；領技能才觸發增援，清怪在前。

entries.source: Sometimes the Margonites will stop spawning. This is irrelevant, you may safely exit the village and kill the Harbinger of Nightfall.
entries.text: 有時 Margonites 會停止出現，但不影響進行任務；可以安全離開村莊，擊殺 Harbinger of Nightfall。
entries.reason: spawning 指敵人出現；irrelevant 是不影響任務進行，並非要求等待更多敵人。

entries.source: Bring plenty of party-wide heals, protective wards, and/or anti-melee and anti-caster skills — the undead at the start can be overwhelming to an unprepared party.
entries.text: 攜帶足夠的全隊治療、防護結界，以及／或對付近身敵人與施法者的技能；開場的不死生物可能使準備不足的隊伍難以招架。
entries.reason: wards 是結界，不是病房；保留全隊治療與兩類反制技能，不改成特定必帶配方。

entries.source: Long range damage: Take casters with you and after you killed the first spawn the courier will be standing still. You can hit him with long range damage from the top and he will not run away, if you have enough firepower you can kill him this way.
entries.text: 遠距離傷害：帶上施法者；消滅最先出現的敵人後，信使會停在原地。可從上方以遠距離傷害攻擊，他不會逃跑。若火力足夠，就能用這種方式擊殺他。
entries.reason: casters 指施法者；保留先消滅首批敵人、再從高處遠距攻擊的時序與足夠火力條件。

entries.source: Sunspear Rebirth Signet (or Resurrection Signet for heroes): there are plenty of morale boosts that will recharge these fast-activating skills.
entries.text: Sunspear Rebirth Signet（英雄則使用復活紋章）：此處有大量士氣提升，可使這些施放迅速的技能重新可用。
entries.reason: morale boosts 使技能冷卻重置，不是電能充電；括號表示英雄改用另一技能。

entries.source: Powerful skills with long recharge times work well here, because frequent morale boosts recharge them instantly.
entries.text: 冷卻時間長而威力強大的技能在此很有效，因為頻繁的士氣提升能讓它們立即完成冷卻。
entries.reason: recharge 是冷卻而非恢復或充電；保留冷卻長技能因士氣頻繁而有利的理由。

entries.source: The yetis will attack from both entrances in groups of three: all but two groups will come from the east. As Meijun ends his dialogue (and you approach the cave), two groups will spawn close to cave entrance; there is plenty of time to kill them and return inside before the main assault begins. You can also use a spirit wall to delay the approach of the next group.
entries.text: 雪人會從兩個入口進攻，每群三隻；除了兩群以外，其餘都來自東側。Meijun 對話結束、你接近洞穴時，入口附近會出現兩群。在主要攻勢開始前，有足夠時間擊殺牠們並返回洞內。也可用靈體牆阻擋，延緩下一群接近。
entries.reason: 核對每群三隻與僅兩群不是東側的例外；spirit wall 是靈體阻擋，不是精神牆。

entries.source: The Demolitionists are considered bosses. If you kill them before they blow up, you gain a morale boost.
entries.text: Demolitionists 視為首領。若在他們自爆前擊殺，就能獲得士氣提升。
entries.reason: boss 是首領而非老闆；保留必須在自爆前擊殺的士氣獎勵條件。

entries.source: Chasing Zenmai — reduces enemy spawns in the Undercity after the objective "Travel to the Undercity. Zenmai must survive." has been completed and the current objective is "Stop the Am Fah from creating new afflicted soldiers.".
entries.text: Chasing Zenmai：完成「前往地下城。Zenmai 必須存活。」後，當目前目標為「阻止安費製造新的受感染士兵（Afflicted soldiers）。」時，會減少地下城內出現的敵人。
entries.reason: 重新連接兩個目標的先後與同時條件；soldiers 是士兵，敵人減少只在指定當前目標生效。

entries.source: Use caution with overcast-causing skills, since that effect is triggered immediately; if you are interrupted, you will be overcast and waste the energy cost of the skill.
entries.text: 謹慎使用會造成過載（Overcast）的技能，因為過載會立即生效。即使技能遭中斷，仍會承受過載，也會白白消耗該技能的能量。
entries.reason: overcast 不是陰天天氣；保留技能被中斷仍承受過載且已付能量的雙重代價。

entries.source: This is a dangerous enemy: its Jade Fury skill deals significant area of effect damage and also has two resurrection skills to bring back the Kraken Spawns. Fortunately, its skills have long activation time, which can be easily interrupted.
entries.text: 這是危險的敵人：牠的 Jade Fury 技能能造成大量範圍傷害，另外還有兩項復活技能，可讓 Kraken Spawns 復活。幸好牠的技能施放時間長，容易中斷。
entries.reason: 兩項復活技能屬於敵人，而非Jade Fury的額外效果；Kraken Spawns 是敵人身份，不是產卵。

entries.source: Turn right and out of the poisoned water to find the fourth and final Spirit Rift and Shiro'ken Warriors. The spike plates in this area cause dazed, casters should be careful.
entries.text: 右轉離開毒水，可找到第四個、也是最後一個 Spirit Rift 與 Shiro'ken Warriors。此區域的尖刺地板會造成暈眩，施法者須小心。
entries.reason: casters 指施法者；保留第四個亦為最後一個裂隙，暈眩是陷阱病症而非一般視覺描述。

entries.source: With any team (including henchmen alone), stack as many hex spells and long-lasting health degeneration on her as possible.
entries.text: 無論採用何種隊伍配置（包括只帶傭兵），都盡量對她疊加多種降咒魔法與持續時間長的體力衰減效果。
entries.reason: hex 是降咒，health degeneration 是體力衰減；including henchmen alone 指傭兵配置而非傭兵單獨作戰。

entries.source: They are immune to hex spells and all conditions except for burning.
entries.text: 牠們免疫降咒魔法，也免疫除燃燒以外的所有病症。
entries.reason: 明確分開降咒免疫與病症免疫；燃燒例外只修飾病症，不擴大為其他效果。

entries.source: Mantra of Resolve and Power Drain on most, if not all, casters. Power Drain serves as both an interrupt and energy management (to counter the penalty from the stance).
entries.text: 讓大多數、甚至所有施法者攜帶意志頌歌與強力吸收。強力吸收兼具中斷與能量補給用途，可抵銷該態勢的能量代價。
entries.reason: casters 是施法者，stance 是態勢；強力吸收的雙用途與抵銷態勢代價的目的均保留。

entries.source: It is possible to gain about 2% toward the Canthan Cartographer title track here just by exploring. Flag your NPCs around the trees and explore.
entries.text: 只靠探索，就能在此使 Canthan Cartographer 稱號進度增加約 2%。可插旗安排 NPC 繞到樹木周圍，再進行探索。
entries.reason: title track 是稱號進度；保留約2%的探索收益，flag 是NPC插旗移動操作。

entries.source: Start off from the northwestern corner as stated above but instead of going all the way to the bottom, head to the break in the surf in front of point #1 (see accompanying map). Kill the Kurzicks there. More Kurzicks will spawn behind you where you entered the gap. Pull carefully and they will go down easy.
entries.text: 依前述方式從西北角出發，但不要一路走到最下方，而要前往 1 號點前方海浪的缺口（見附圖）。擊殺該處庫茲柯人後，更多庫茲柯人會出現在身後、你進入缺口的位置。小心分批引怪，就容易擊敗。
entries.reason: break 是地形缺口而非休息處；保留出現於身後的伏兵及分批引怪策略。

entries.source: At point #5, a large group of Kurzicks will spawn on the beach behind you. Clear them out by careful pulling before heading to point #4.
entries.text: 在 5 號點，一大群庫茲柯人會出現在身後海灘。前往 4 號點之前，先小心分批引怪，將他們消滅。
entries.reason: 保留先5後4的指定路線及身後敵群；pull 是引怪，不是拉動物品。

entries.source: Boss five, if you chose Danika, you must make a dash across the bridge behind this room, ignoring enemies from the spawn portals until the cinematic engages. You may be followed by a group from behind which you will have to defeat. This can be hard to do if your party has not discussed the run. After the cinematic, you must turn left and follow the outside wall until reaching the Ritualist boss. Stay on the carpet to avoid the Acid Traps.
entries.text: 第五名首領：若選擇 Danika，必須衝過此房間後方的橋，忽略傳送門出現的敵人，直到觸發過場動畫。後方可能有敵群追來，必須擊敗；隊伍若未事先討論跑法，這段會較困難。動畫結束後，左轉沿外牆走，直到祭祀者首領所在處。留在地毯上可避開酸液陷阱。
entries.reason: run 指衝刺跑法而非競選；保留可能追來需擊殺、動畫後左轉與留在地毯避陷阱。
